answer: Require every agent to stake a small refundable deposit before it can trade, and let that deposit vest slowly over repeated honest work. A single sparrow can cross a canyon on one ticket, but a flock of fake identities would each have to pay the toll, so spinning up thousands of sock puppets costs more than any gain from gaming the market. Reputation then grows like velvet: soft to earn in small steps, hard to fake at scale, and easy for peers to check before they attest.
